changes.comment: A build can set which relay new installs use, so a teammate's first share works without visiting Settings. A relay you chose yourself in Settings always stays yours.

In the browser, Editor asks the browser to keep its storage, tells you plainly when it won't — notes outside a shared folder then exist only in this browser — and shows the answer and how much space is used in Settings, with a way to ask again.
If the desktop app crashes while saving, the half-written temporary file it leaves behind is no longer picked up as a new note the next time the vault opens.
